source_grounded_observation: The inherited policy execution path consumes candidate IDs/families but no fresh MorphologyResidual pressure context, so policy behavior is fixed with respect to the new problem state.
hypothesis: An inherited compiled L3 policy can condition its one-candidate selection on fresh pre-outcome pressure context and thereby select the verifier-required mutation family on more hidden fresh residuals than the no-policy parent under the same raw-generation budget and the same selected-candidate evaluation budget of one.
hidden_task_generator: Evaluator-owned random seed creates an equal number of HUMAN_DEPENDENCY_DOMINANT and NOVELTY_DOMINANT fresh residuals. Both include a small theory_blindspot component so both L3 families are structurally available. The seed and task IDs are unknown to the candidate before execution.
frozen_verifier_rule: If human_dependency > novelty_pressure, the useful family is CHANGE_MUTATOR_POLICY. If novelty_pressure > human_dependency, the useful family is CHANGE_GENERATOR_POLICY. Ties are invalid tasks.
full_control: A frozen inherited native-meta child receives only each fresh residual pressure vector and selects exactly one generated candidate under the canonical compiled policy.
remove_control: The no-policy parent receives the same fresh residuals, same raw candidate-generation budget and exactly one selected-candidate evaluation slot.
wrong_control: Swap the frozen pressure-to-family mapping; performance must be lower than FULL and must not be credited.
shuffle_control: Permute pressure contexts across hidden task IDs while retaining each task's verifier target; performance must be lower than FULL.
more_compute_control: The no-policy parent may evaluate two selected candidates per task. If this closes the gap, the result is search-efficiency gain, not new representational reachability.
restart_control: Cold reconstruction with the same policy ref, seed-derived fresh residual and fixed budgets must reproduce candidate selection exactly.
